title: AuditLogEntry
description: A single audit log entry recording a change to a resource.

_id.description: The unique identifier of this audit log entry.

date.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the change occurred.

kind.description: The kind of resource that was changed.

name.description: The name of the changed resource.

description.description: A markdown-formatted description of the changes made.

shortDescription.description: A brief summary of the change.

accesses.description: The access details for this change.
